title: Scalar restrictions and unit-normalized direct-image squares
statement: Let l be prime, E=ULift Q_l, f:X→S a scheme morphism, and choose the localizations of def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models at X and S. Given a coefficient-tower Base b, its geometric operations g over f [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], normalized Chern data cS,cX [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and specified total right derived models Rf,Rt for constant-coefficient direct image and its strict-tower version, there are exact scalar Restriction records rS,rX, normalized Coefficients records for cS,cX [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients], a total right derived completed direct image Rc, and ordinary direct-image squares identity on all sections. The varying square has ExactSquareOfUniverses data with canonicalDiagonalRightDerived(g.push) and Rt; the completed square has ExactSquare data with Rc and Rf. Both retain the full common-unit normalization on all complexes. This assertion involves neither twisting, a projective-line model, derived limits nor Milnor invertibility.

proof.text: Apply exists_diagonalTraceOrdinaryScalars to obtain exact scalar restrictions, both normalized coefficient cones, and the two sectionwise ordinary direct-image isomorphisms.

Obtain the unit-isomorphism criterion on restricted K-injectives for both destination pushforwards. Choose Rc as canonicalDiagonalRightDerived of completed direct image; its source is Grothendieck abelian by the ringed-site K-injective-resolution theorem.

For an ordinary square F⋙V≅U⋙G with U,V exact, form the two full cochain units for RF⋙D(V) and D(U)⋙RG. The first is invertible on K-injectives by RF.computation and exactness of V; the second by the preceding acyclicity criterion. An additive functor carries quasi-isomorphisms between K-injectives to quasi-isomorphisms, since these maps are homotopy equivalences. Thus both units derive F⋙V. Mathlib rightDerivedUnique gives their comparison isomorphism, including when source and destination localization universes differ. Its rightDerivedNatTrans_app equation, conjugated by the exact-functor localization factorization isomorphisms, is exactly the full ExactSquareOfUniverses normalization. Apply this proved helper to the varying square and completed square, and repackage the latter as ExactSquare.

theorem exists_diagonalTraceScalarComparisons (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) b f)
    (cS : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S)
    (cX : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X)
    (nS : cS.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (nX : cX.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (Rf : DiagonalRightDerived
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f))
    (Rt : DiagonalRightDerived (diagonalTraceSystemPush l f)) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    letI : g.push.Additive := g.pushAdditive
    letI : HasKInjectiveResolutions (Systems X (Arings l E X)) := b.kinjective X
    ∃ (rS : Restriction l E S) (rX : Restriction l E X),
      letI : rS.F.Additive := rS.additive
      letI : rX.F.Additive := rX.additive
      letI : PreservesFiniteLimits rS.F := rS.limits
      letI : PreservesFiniteColimits rS.F := rS.colimits
      letI : PreservesFiniteLimits rX.F := rX.limits
      letI : PreservesFiniteColimits rX.F := rX.colimits
      Nonempty (Coefficients l E S cS rS) ∧
      Nonempty (Coefficients l E X cX rX) ∧
      ∃ Rc : DiagonalRightDerived (diagonalTracePush l f),
      ∃ varyingOrdinary : g.push ⋙ rS.F ≅ rX.F ⋙ diagonalTraceSystemPush l f,
      ∃ varying_sections : ∀ (M : Systems X (Arings l E X)) (n : ℕ) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (x : (((g.push ⋙ rS.F).obj M).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq (((varyingOrdinary.hom.app M).app (op n)).hom.app U x) x,
      Nonempty (ExactSquareOfUniverses g.push (diagonalTraceSystemPush l f)
        rX.F rS.F (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived g.push) Rt varyingOrdinary) ∧
      ∃ completedOrdinary : diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S ≅
        diagonalCompletedRestriction l X ⋙
          lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f,
      ∃ completed_sections : ∀ (M : DiagonalCompleted l X) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (x : ((diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).obj M).obj.obj U),
        HEq ((completedOrdinary.hom.app M).hom.app U x) x,
      Nonempty (ExactSquare (diagonalTracePush l f)
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f)
        (diagonalCompletedRestriction l X) (diagonalCompletedRestriction l S)
        Rc Rf completedOrdinary)
